aiDescription.summary: The bill directs USDA Rural Development to reserve at least 2.5% of appropriated funds per discretionary grant program to provide technical and predevelopment assistance so low‑capacity rural communities can prepare and implement projects. Supports training, environmental review, outreach, and application development for broadband, water/wastewater, housing, and community projects; prioritizes persistent‑poverty, underserved, or low‑capacity areas and eligible local, Tribal, nonprofit, cooperative, extension, college, or private entities.

impact.summary: The bill requires USDA to reserve at least 2.5% of funds for Rural Development grants for technical assistance, pre‑development, outreach, and application support for broadband, water/wastewater, housing, and community projects. USDA Rural Development (RUS, RBCS, RHS) and State offices would fund technical‑assistance providers—local and Tribal governments, nonprofits, co‑ops, land‑grant colleges, and private firms—for low‑capacity and persistent‑poverty rural areas.

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Agriculture.
